How to ensure this Case stand out on QA


  1. Ensure the AWB number is captured where possible.
  2. AWB Refresh button is used to fetch details from iCargo.
  3. You only work on the Case when you have the ownership of it.
  4. Type | Sub Type 1 | Sub Type 2 | Issue Type | Issue Type root cause | comments are up to date prior to the closure of the case.
  5. Review the important Flags section prior to closure.


Important Guidelines on expections when the Case is pushed from CSU to CSS or vice versa

  1. Ensure you have taken the ownership of the case before you start working on it.
  2. When you are ready to pus hthe case out, make sure you add the case comments and change the ownership from yourself to the queue.
